content: We need to find a retrosynthetic template that when applied to the given molecule reproduces the described forward reaction: aromatic amine attacks electrophilic sulfur of phenylsulfonyl chloride, then collapse to expel Cl- and base deprotonates N-H to give sulfonamide. So forward reaction: phenylsulfonyl chloride + aromatic amine -> sulfonamide + HCl (or base). In retrosynthesis, we break N-S bond (formed) and break S-Cl bond (broken). So we need a template where functional groups formed: sulfonamides (N-S). Broken: S-Cl. Also maybe bonds formed: N-S, maybe S=O unchanged. So we need to search template catalog with criteria: functional_groups_formed includes "sulfonamides"? Let's see available functional groups list.
